shop.demo.menu.intro:
* Welcome to the demo shop.
* Take a look around.
shop.demo.buy.bandage.desc:
Heals 10 HP.
Used, but still
good.
shop.demo.buy.stick.desc:
A stick.
Weapon AT 0.
Only 2 in stock.
shop.demo.buy.ribbon.desc:
DEF 3 armor.
Was locked until
you talked.
shop.demo.buy.phone.desc:
A cell phone.
Opens the menu.
shop.demo.buy.mystery.name: Mystery Box
shop.demo.buy.mystery.desc:
Restores a lot of HP.
Smooth texture.
Never runs out.
shop.demo.talk.0:
* This is a demo shop.
* Stock, locks, sellout —
  all wired in.
shop.demo.talk.0.b:
* Oh — that ribbon?
* It's on the shelf now.
* You asked, so it's yours
  to buy.
shop.demo.talk.1:
* Built UTE-style.
* No shop commands
  in the typer.
shop.demo.talk.1.b:
* Host events only.
* With 1+ kills, this
  shop turns geno.
shop.demo.talk.2:
* Always carry a spare
  bandage.
* You never know when
  you'll need it.
shop.demo.talk.3:
* Why did the skeleton
  cross the road?
*&* ...
* He didn't.
  He fell apart.
shop.demo.talk.4:
* Psst... the Mystery Box
  is totally worth it.
* Trust me.
shop.demo.talk.bonus.name: Hidden joke
shop.demo.talk.bonus:
* OK fine, one more.
*&* What do you call a
  skeleton who won't work?
* Lazy bones!
shop.demo.unlock.ribbon:
* (The faded ribbon is
  now for sale.)
shop.demo.sell.stick.refuse:
* No.
* I am NOT buying
  that stick back.
